2) For any deal with >$250k ARR movement, add a 2–3 sentence note in the "Narrative" column (short bullets).
3) Security/compliance blockers: flag if SOC2/arch review is outstanding. If so, include the expected completion date.
4) Pricing/discount ask: mark with a red flag and copy finance on the thread (we'll escalate in Thursday sync).
